relationships.subject: synovial vascular endothelial cells
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of endothelial cells in the synovial fibrosis environment promoted the secretion of Netrin‐1

relationships.subject: Netrin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: This further demonstrates that endothelial cell activation promotes Netrin‐1 secretion to mediate neural sprouting through the regulation of DCC/UNC5 repulsion and attraction.

relationships.subject: Netrin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of pain‐related factors CGRP, SP and NGF in blood was significantly increased in the KOA and TGF‐β groups compared to the normal group, while the expression in the TGF‐β inhibition and Netrin‐1 groups was significantly decreased compared to the KOA group

key_findings: In KOA rats, synovial fibrosis activated endothelial cells to secrete Netrin-1, increasing DCC/GAP43, decreasing UNC5 in DRG, and raising CGRP, SP and NGF.
Inhibiting TGF-β or Netrin-1 reduced nerve sprouting markers and pain factors and prolonged paw lift time.
